description: Impulse and activity data storage must be invariant across opencode/metabob-cli instances for a given (metabob_api_key, project_id) pair. Storage access must be location-independent, vessel flow (metabob-opencode -> metabob-cli -> metabob-rpc-api) must be respected, and debugging/upgrade capabilities must work from any instance without local-only state that breaks cross-instance consistency.
expectedBehavior: Given same (metabob_api_key, project_id): Instance A creates impulse/activity -> Instance B retrieves same data -> Both instances see identical state -> Vessel flow boundaries are enforced (no direct RPC calls from opencode, must go through CLI) -> No local state breaks cross-instance access

currentState.summary: Storage is PARTIALLY instance-invariant. Local filesystem storage is instance-specific, but vessel flow to backend (via CLI MCP) enables cross-instance access when properly configured.
currentState.architecture: Two-tier storage: Local (Storage.ts) + Remote (CLI MCP -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB)
currentState.vesselFlow: opencode -> Storage.ts -> (no MCP call) -> Local filesystem ONLY
currentState.problem: Storage.ts bypasses CLI MCP entirely, writing only to local filesystem. This violates vessel flow architecture and prevents cross-instance data access.

desiredState.summary: Storage must be FULLY instance-invariant via vessel flow enforcement
desiredState.architecture: All storage operations MUST flow through CLI MCP to backend
desiredState.vesselFlow: opencode -> impulse tool -> CLI MCP tool -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB
desiredState.requirement: No local-only state that breaks cross-instance consistency
desiredState.implementation: Dual-write pattern: Local storage for caching + CLI MCP call for cross-instance persistence

components.currentBehavior: Writes to local filesystem at Global.Path.data/storage. Uses Bun.write() to persist JSON files. No backend calls.
components.desiredBehavior: Should call CLI MCP tools (metabob_impulse_store, metabob_activity_save) which forward to rpc-api
components.gap: NO vessel flow enforcement - direct local writes bypass CLI and backend entirely

components.currentBehavior: Writes impulse to SessionMemory.addImpulse() -> Activity.addImpulses() -> Activity.save() -> Storage.write(['activity', id]). All local filesystem.
components.desiredBehavior: After local write, should call CLI MCP tool metabob_impulse_store() to sync to backend
components.gap: No backend sync - impulses only exist on local instance

components.currentBehavior: Syncs impulse from SessionMemory to Activity.impulses, then saves to local storage via Activity.save()
components.desiredBehavior: Should include backend sync step via CLI MCP tool

components.currentBehavior: Saves session memory to Storage.write(['session-memory', sessionID]). Local filesystem only.
components.desiredBehavior: Should call CLI MCP tool for backend persistence

components.currentBehavior: Saves activity to Storage.write(['activity', id]). Local filesystem only.
components.desiredBehavior: Should call CLI MCP tool metabob_activity_save() for backend sync
components.gap: No backend sync - activities not accessible cross-instance

components.currentBehavior: CLI MCP tool that forwards impulse data to rpc-api /v2/impulses endpoint. Implements correct vessel flow: opencode -> CLI -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB
components.desiredBehavior: Already correct - this IS the vessel flow endpoint
components.gap: NONE - CLI tool is properly implemented

components.currentBehavior: CLI MCP tool that retrieves impulse from rpc-api /v2/impulses/{id} endpoint with (api_key, project_id) scoping
components.desiredBehavior: Already correct - implements proper cross-instance retrieval
components.gap: NONE - CLI tool is properly implemented

components.currentBehavior: Loads from Storage.read(['activity', id]). Local filesystem only. No fallback to backend.
components.desiredBehavior: Should try local first, then call CLI MCP tool metabob_activity_load() as fallback for cross-instance access
components.gap: Missing backend fallback - cannot load activities created by other instances

current.impulseCreate: User -> impulse_create tool -> SessionMemory.addImpulse -> Activity.addImpulses -> Activity.save -> Storage.write -> Local filesystem
current.impulseLoad: User -> impulse_load tool -> SessionMemory.getImpulse -> Local memory ONLY

desired.impulseCreate: User -> impulse_create tool -> SessionMemory.addImpulse -> Activity.addImpulses -> Activity.save -> Storage.write (local) + CLI MCP metabob_impulse_store -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB
desired.impulseLoad: User -> impulse_load tool -> SessionMemory.getImpulse (try local) -> CLI MCP metabob_impulse_load (fallback) -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB
desired.activitySave: Activity.save -> Storage.write (local) + CLI MCP metabob_activity_save -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB
desired.activityLoad: Activity.load -> Storage.read (try local) -> CLI MCP metabob_activity_load (fallback) -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB

opencode.role: Frontend vessel - user interaction, tool execution, local caching
mustNOT: Make direct HTTP calls to rpc-api
Use fetch() to call backend endpoints
must: Call CLI MCP tools for backend operations
Use local storage for caching only, not source of truth

cli.role: Gateway vessel - MCP tool provider, vessel flow enforcement
must: Forward all storage operations to rpc-api

rpcApi.role: Backend vessel - persistence, multi-tenancy, database access
must: Store in SurrealDB for cross-instance access
Return consistent data regardless of requesting instance

current.description: Storage.ts writes directly to local filesystem, bypassing CLI MCP entirely
current.impact: Impulses and activities are NOT instance-invariant - Instance A cannot access Instance B's data

current.description: impulse_create tool does not call metabob_impulse_store after local write
current.impact: Impulses exist only on creating instance

current.description: Activity.load only checks local storage, no CLI MCP fallback
current.impact: Cannot load activities created by other instances

current.description: SessionMemory.save writes to local storage without backend sync
current.impact: Session memory not shared across instances

phase1_dualWrite.description: Add backend sync AFTER local writes (dual-write pattern)

changes.change: After SessionMemory.addImpulse and Activity.addImpulses, call CLI MCP metabob_impulse_store()
After Storage.write in Activity.save(), call CLI MCP metabob_activity_save()

phase2_readFallback.description: Add backend fallback for read operations

changes.change: In Activity.load(), if Storage.read fails, call CLI MCP metabob_activity_load()
changes.example: try { local } catch { await MCP.call('metabob_activity_load', { activity_id, project_id }) }

changes.change: If SessionMemory.getImpulse returns null, call CLI MCP metabob_impulse_load()

tests: Verify no direct RPC imports in opencode

keyInsights.cli_implements_correct_flow: metabob_impulse_store and metabob_impulse_load in CLI already implement correct vessel flow and cross-instance storage via rpc-api /v2/impulses endpoint
keyInsights.opencode_bypasses_cli: opencode Storage.ts writes directly to local filesystem without calling CLI MCP tools
keyInsights.dual_storage_needed: Local storage for caching + backend storage (via CLI) for cross-instance invariance
keyInsights.project_id_scoping: Backend uses (api_key, project_id) for multi-tenancy - project_id is git root hash
